description: This file defines an abstract base class for UI tests using Selenium WebDriver and JUnit5, providing setup and teardown methods, configuration loading, and test assumptions tailored for different run modes.

classes.name: BaseUiTest
classes.description: Abstract base class for setting up and tearing down UI tests for the OrangeHRM application with Selenium and JUnit5.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test configuration, applies metadata, and creates WebDriver instance before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Quits the WebDriver instance after each test if it was initialized.

methods.name: assumeRealMode
methods.description: Skips the test if running in discovery-only mode.
